title: Stratified A/B runway with timewarp replay and rollback playbook
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds stratified A/B runway controller, deterministic traffic replay (timewarp), resumable snapshotting for rollouts, enhanced telemetry gating and an operator rollback playbook.
description: Motivation: We need safer, auditable multi-cohort A/B experiments with fast, deterministic replay windows and an operator-friendly rollback playbook. This PR implements a "stratified runway" controller that runs A/B experiments over stratified cohorts, captures compact rollout snapshots, and supports 'timewarp' replay of a captured traffic slice to reproduce regressions locally or in a canary cluster. Key goals are: reproducible debugging, resumable rollouts after partial failures, clear telemetry gates for automatic rollback, and a documented playbook for SREs and PMs. Changes include controller, simulator, telemetry gating, CLI helpers, and e2e tests. Checklist: - [x] controller reconciliation loop and API (feature flagged); - [x] compact snapshot format (protobuf) + metadata tagging; - [x] deterministic timewarp replay engine (simulator/integration); - [x] telemetry gates and SLO-based rollback rules; - [x] CLI tools to export/import snapshots and trigger replay; - [x] e2e smoke tests and integration with staging; - [x] operator playbook and runbook doc. Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/ENG-7621/stratified-ab-runway-design, playbook draft at docs/playbooks/stratified-ab-runway.md. High-level commit summary: see commits field below. High-level changed areas: see changed_files field below. Testing and rollout plan: tested locally with simulator against synthetic cohorts, ran staged promotion in staging cluster with 5000 synthetic sessions, and validated rollback triggered correctly when latency SLO exceeded threshold. We'll feature-flag the controller and roll it out to a small set of internal customers before full GA. Operator notes: use rollout_ctl export-snapshot --window to capture a traffic slice; replay with rollout_ctl timewarp --snapshot; if automatic rollback triggers, follow the playbook: inspect snapshot replay, check drift metrics, optionally resume with --resume-snapshot after fix. This PR is intentionally conservative: no changes to main serving runtime kernels, only orchestration and tooling; full migration guide included in docs. Merge summary: squash-merged after green CI and 2 approvals.

review_comments: Ethan Brooks (2025-09-11): Overall looks good. Two asks: 1) add a max-snapshot-size guard and surface an error in the CLI; 2) clarify how cohort hashing is stable across deployments. See inline comment in stratified_runway.go.

Maya Patel (2025-09-11): Addressed both points: added snapshot hard limit (16MB) with sane defaults and improved cohort hashing to include model version and region. Added unit tests for hashing stability.
Lina Gomez (2025-09-12): Can we make the replay engine configurable to run in 'dry-run' mode that doesn't touch the admission path? Also requested a comment on thread-safety in replay_engine.go.
Maya Patel (2025-09-12): Added --dry-run flag to timewarp and a concurrency-safe replay queue; documented limitations in replay_engine.go.

Noah Rivera (2025-09-14): Observability: please emit a replay.trace_id and correlate with rollout.trace_id so debugging across services is simpler. Also asked for an e2e that verifies trace correlation.
Maya Patel (2025-09-15): Added replay.trace_id propagation and an integration test that asserts trace tags are present in the synthetic traces.
ci_details: Pipeline: build -> unit-tests -> linters -> integration (staging) -> e2e. First run: linters flagged formatting in replay_engine.go and integration flaked on a test (replay timing); fixes pushed and CI re-run. Final status: all checks passed. Artifacts: rollout_ctl binary, snapshot proto schema, e2e logs attached to the PR build.
testing_notes: Unit tests cover hashing stability, snapshot serialization, gating policy evaluation; simulator stress test ran with 100k synthetic sessions across 8 cohorts for performance profiling; staging e2e validated automatic rollback on latency regression and successful resume after a synthetic fix. Manual smoke: exported snapshot from staging, replayed in isolated cluster, reproduced the latency bump and validated rollback rule fired.
